string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Pin app shortcuts to the sphere, like a new incognito tab or Compose in Gmail: search for them in the sphere\'s editor, or hold one in search and choose Pin to home.
The sphere\'s editor has a search bar at the bottom, like search\'s, with a round Done button beside it, both within reach of your thumb.

The clock, camera and browser buttons can open an app you choose, and any button or the date can open one of an app\'s shortcuts. Hold one to choose; until you do, the clock, camera and browser open your phone\'s defaults.
As you type, chips above the search bar suggest filters that fit, like Contacts, Settings or PDFs. Type \"!\" and a name to call one up yourself: \"!pdf\" lists your PDFs.
Alarm times work without a colon: \"alarm 730\".
